label: Join root is the stage-two root; registering the composition is blocked by sense mixing
summary: Question (modal spine, next investigation 3): is the ungrounded individual of the join (NecessaryConcreteUnderivedAt m w, STMT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-UNDERIVED-AT) the root the stage-two chain to NecessaryClassicalGodRootAt (STMT-NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-ROOT) starts from, without the regress premises? Finding: yes, under the stage-two premises. The Lean theorem TruthCore.Results.Causality.NecessaryClassicalGodRootFromUnderived.derive (unregistered module, Solution.lean beside a frozen Challenge.lean) composes UnderivedRootPerfection.derive, PerfectRootPositiveIntellectWill.derive and ClassicalGodFromPositiveRoot.derive on ONE signature carrier, model, world, q3 profile and predicate dictionary. Inputs: the underived individual, excluded middle, and the 21 act/being, attribute and naming premises of NecessaryClassicalGodRoot.derive, unchanged. It drops population (STMT-COGITO-INHABITED-CONCRETE-WORLD), whole-roster nontrapping (STMT-WHOLE-ROSTER-NOT-TRAPPED) and contingent grounding (STMT-EVERY-CONTINGENT-GROUNDED-AT); no extra premise is needed. Inspection of NecessaryClassicalGodRoot.derive, RootPositiveIntellectWill.derive and DirectEsseRootPerfectionGoodness.derive confirms that hPop, hWhole and hDep are used only to obtain the root (through DirectEsseRootPerfection.derive): simplicity, firstness, esse/essence identity, remoteness, intellect, will, maximum identification (maximumEqualsRoot, or ClassicalGodFromPositiveRoot's direct argument), uniqueness among actual roots, naming, pure act, infinity and eternity use only ActualRoot at w, NecessaryAt, the retained uniqueness clause and the retained interfaces. The join's all-world support exclusion is used only at w. Uniqueness is among selected actual concrete roots, not all necessary individuals. Local evidence on this branch: lake build of the Solution and Challenge; scripts/verify-result.sh (Comparator and NanoDa) accepted it, and corpus.py bind-check bound its 23 hypotheses exactly to the reused premise statements, under a temporary result record and local allowlist entry that were then removed and are NOT committed. The statement-level route was not new: underived-root-perfection, perfect-root-positive-intellect-will and classical-god-from-positive-root already chain STMT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-UNDERIVED-AT to STMT-NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-ROOT, so truth frontier-diff with the registered composition showed no premise change (421 open premises reaching the root, 303 support alternatives, before and after). The value of the composition is the single-term check that the three separately verified theorems compose with every parameter aligned and the same witness. No premise is established; J1, J2, F1 and the stage-one premises upstream of the underived individual stay open.
blocker: A new corpus argument concluding STMT-NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-ROOT fails the sense-index gate (truth check: 'uses senses ... without a sense bridge'). Its conclusion statement links two or more senses each of NECESSARY (NECESSARY_2, NECESSARY_4, NECESSARY_11), CAUSE_OF_ESSE_VERSUS_SUFFICIENT_REASON (_1, _2), MAXIMAL_IN_A_SELECTED_PERFECTION_GREATEST (_1, _6), NECESSITY_OF_ONE_INDIVIDUAL_VERSUS_NECESSARY (_1, _4), WELL_FOUNDEDNESS_AND_ANTI_BRUTE_ROOT (_1, _2), NONNECESSARY_VERSUS_CONTINGENT_ROOT (_1, _2), INTRINSIC_PRODUCTIVE_CONTRIBUTION_VERSUS_SOURCE_BACKED (_1, _2) and GOD (GOD_1, GOD_4); the reused premises add WORLD_RELATIVE_EXISTENCE_METAPHYSICAL_ESSE_NECESSITY _3 (underived statement) against _1 (ExistingInActAt, EsseCauseIsActualConcreteGround, SimplyPriorIsActualConcreteGround) and POTENCY_CAPACITY_AND_POWER_ACROSS_ADOPTED _1 (act prior to potency) against _2 (not act and potency in the same respect). All four existing arguments to this conclusion are on corpus/sense-index-allowlist.json, which may only shrink (#1233), and no premise relates these senses, so a sense bridge would be invented. Next step: a sense-index cleanup of STMT-NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-ROOT's definition links (for example, whether NecessaryAt-only content should link IsNecessaryPerSe or Modal.Frame senses at all) and of the WORLD_RELATIVE_EXISTENCE and POTENCY compound disambiguations, after which the frozen Challenge can be registered with its records. Reopen if the endpoint statement is split per sense or a stated premise relating the senses is added.
